verdict.rationale: Recruitee's API covers core recruiting objects (candidates, offers, departments, locations, webhooks) and the Careers API supports public job/application workflows, but the token scope note explicitly limits API tokens to a narrow set of endpoints (/offers, /offers/:id, /offers/:offer_slug/candidates) rather than full parity with UI features like reporting/insights, referrals, eSignatures, texting, or agency management shown on the features page. missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints for reporting/analytics, eSignatures, referrals, texting/WhatsApp, agency management, and a published OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage (probe found no openapi.json).
